dataset.name: AWS PetShop RCA (Hardt et al., CLeaR 2024)

protocol.primary_split: test (48 issues: low 18, high 18, temporal1 6, temporal2 6)
protocol.tuning_split: train (20 issues; every root cause is PetSearch_AWS::ECS::Fargate)
protocol.normal_period: noissue/metrics.csv in full (589 rows low/high, 1652 temporal)
protocol.AC@k: tie-aware expected top-k hit, one root cause per issue; Avg@5 = mean AC@1..5

declared_traversal.rule: max train AC@3 on answered s.t. coverage >= 0.5; ties -> smallest tau

ranked_correlation.rule: max train AC@3 on answered s.t. coverage >= 0.5; ties -> smallest tau

learned_traversal.rule: no tau reached train coverage 0.5; tau = 0

P15.statement: declared topology plus abstention beats learned-graph RCA on AC@3 by at least 0.1; refuted if the gap is under 0.03

post_hoc_vs_b_lat.note: post hoc; not the pre-registered comparison
